bio: I am an AI Systems Engineer and 4th-year Computer Science student at IIIT Vadodara (Class of 2027), specializing in Agentic AI, LLM applications, and scalable backend architecture. My experience spans production FastAPI & Django microservices, multi-agent workflows with LangGraph, advanced RAG architectures, and Clinical NLP research (PubMedBERT & Federated Learning). I design production-oriented AI infrastructure that connects reliable APIs, retrieval systems, and transformer-based workflows.
